summary: Cross-subdomain exchange token authentication system fully tested. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend login flow, ProtectedRoute subdomain config check, and Domain Manager UI verified working correctly.

issues: DialogContent accessibility warnings in console (missing DialogTitle) - not blocking functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Backend auth.py: Exchange token endpoints (create/redeem/subdomain-config) well-implemented with proper security - single-use tokens, 30s TTL, session auth_method tracking
Frontend subdomainAuth.js: Clean service with all necessary helpers (extractAndCleanExchangeToken, buildLoginRedirectUrl, buildAppRedirectUrl, etc.)
Frontend AuthContext.js: Properly handles exchange token redemption on init (lines 87-111) with session storage of token and expiry
Frontend App.js ProtectedRoute: Correctly loads subdomain config async before deciding redirect path (lines 62-103)
Frontend LoginPage.js: handleSubmit properly handles cross-subdomain redirect flow with exchange token creation
seed_data_creation: Exchange tokens created during testing are single-use and auto-expire in 30 seconds
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cross-subdomain auth system tested and working. Backend: 3 new endpoints (create/redeem/subdomain-config) all functional. Frontend: AuthContext handles exchange token redemption, ProtectedRoute checks subdomain config, LoginPage handles redirect parameter. The cross-subdomain redirect only activates on *.koodh.com hostnames - preview.emergentagent.com uses normal /login flow. Domain Manager shows 2 active routes: clara.koodh.com (app) and login.koodh.com (auth).

GET_subdomain_config.details: Returns enabled=true, base_domain='koodh.com', login_url='https://login.koodh.com', app_url='https://clara.koodh.com', routes array with clara and login

POST_exchange_token_create_requires_auth.details: Returns 403 Forbidden when called without authentication

POST_exchange_token_create_success.details: Creates token with UUID format and expires_in=30 seconds

POST_exchange_token_redeem_no_auth.details: Successfully redeems token without authentication, returns JWT + user data

Exchange_token_single_use.details: Second redemption attempt returns 401 'Exchange token already used'

Session_auth_method_tracked.details: Session created from exchange token has auth_method='exchange_token' (verified via code review and working session)

Normal_login_flow_works.details: Standard email/password login continues to work on preview environment

Frontend_login_page.details: Login form renders correctly, accepts credentials, redirects on success

Frontend_login_wizard.details: Login wizard appears once after login, does NOT reappear on navigation

Frontend_ProtectedRoute.details: Redirects to /login when not authenticated, loads subdomain config before deciding redirect path

Domain_Manager_UI.details: Shows 4 tabs (Overzicht, Site Domeinen, Subdomain Routing, Cloudflare), displays active routes including clara.koodh.com and login.koodh.com

Subdomain_routes_configured.details: clara.koodh.com (Applicatie/app) and login.koodh.com (Authenticatie/auth) routes visible in Domain Manager

mocked_apis.notes: All APIs are real, no mocking. Exchange tokens stored in MongoDB exchange_tokens collection.

security_verification.no_auth_for_redeem: VERIFIED - Redeem works without auth (by design)
security_verification.session_tracking: VERIFIED - auth_method='exchange_token' set in session document
